new_candidates.body:
### Summary

The USD decoder only handles `PhysicsFilteredPairsAPI` when it is applied to a rigid body and targets another rigid body. Other forms that UsdPhysics allows either fail to compile the whole model or are silently ignored. Separately, `newton:selfCollisionEnabled` on `NewtonArticulationRootAPI` is declared in `newton_tokens.h` but never read.

Verified at runtime with the `mujoco-usd` 4.0.1 wheel. `plugin/usd_decoder` is unchanged on `main` since the 4.0.1 tag.

### Details

UsdPhysics says *"The FilteringPairsAPI can be applied to objects with a UsdPhysicsRigidBodyAPI, UsdPhysicsCollisionAPI, or UsdPhysicsArticulationRootAPI"*, and that a relationship from A to B implies the one from B to A ([`overview.dox`](https://github.com/PixarAnimationStudios/OpenUSD/blob/3ed9ded5b9a8469e0f37525afbbad95c1e09f2a8/pxr/usd/usdPhysics/overview.dox#L497-L516), and the `PhysicsFilteredPairsAPI` schema doc: *"can be applied either to a body or collision or even articulation"*).

`ParseUsdFilteredPairsAPI` is only called from `ParseUsdPhysicsRigidbody`, and copies each target path into `mjsExclude::bodyname2`. So:

| Authored | Result |
| --- | --- |
| Rigid body → rigid body | `<exclude>`, correct |
| Rigid body → static collider (e.g. a floor) | Compile error: `body '/World/floor' not found in bodypair 0` |
| Rigid body → collider under another rigid body | Compile error: `body '/World/A/geom' not found in bodypair 0` |
| API applied on a collider | Ignored; the pair still collides |

The compile errors are the worst part: a single spec-valid filtered pair makes the whole stage fail to load.

For self collisions, `ParseNewtonArticulationRootAPI` reads `newton:jointsAddMobility` but not `newton:selfCollisionEnabled`. The [Newton schema](https://github.com/newton-physics/newton-usd-schemas/blob/ac1107ad54957bed3f85caf6a04f8774ea6a84a1/newton_usd_schemas/generatedSchema.usda#L349-L353) (v0.4.0, the version MuJoCo pins) defines `false` as *"equivalent to applying `PhysicsFilteredPairsAPI` relationships between all bodies in the articulation"*, so there is a direct MuJoCo equivalent: an `<exclude>` for each pair of bodies in the articulation.

### Why it matters

- Collider-level filtered pairs are valid UsdPhysics, and one of them is enough to make the whole stage fail to load in MuJoCo. Filtering a body against a static collider such as a floor is a common case.
- When the API is applied on a collider, the filtering is silently lost, so the model loads but generates contacts the asset explicitly disabled.
- `newton:selfCollisionEnabled = false` is the Newton schema's way to disable self collisions for an articulation, and MuJoCo already parses `NewtonArticulationRootAPI`. Ignoring it silently re-enables self collisions.

### Request

1. Resolve each filtered-pair endpoint to the colliders it covers: a rigid body to its colliders, a collider to itself, a static collider to that geom on the world body, and an articulation root to all colliders in the articulation. When both sides cover whole MuJoCo bodies, emit `<exclude>` as today, using `world` for static colliders when the pair covers all of the world body's colliders.
2. Parse `PhysicsFilteredPairsAPI` on colliders and articulation roots as well as rigid bodies.
3. For collider-level pairs that `<exclude>` can't express, set `contype`/`conaffinity` on the affected geoms, or at minimum warn and skip the pair instead of failing to compile.
4. For `newton:selfCollisionEnabled = false`, add an `<exclude>` for each pair of bodies in the articulation. Parent-child pairs are already filtered by default, so those can be skipped.

### Reproduction

`pip install mujoco-usd==4.0.1`, then:

<details>
<summary>repro.py</summary>

```python
import tempfile

import mujoco
import mujoco._usd  # registers the USD decoder plugin
from pxr import Gf, Sdf, Usd, UsdGeom, UsdPhysics


def collider(stage, path, pos, body=True):
    prim = UsdGeom.Sphere.Define(stage, path)
    prim.CreateRadiusAttr(0.1)
    prim.AddTranslateOp().Set(Gf.Vec3d(*pos))
    if body:
        UsdPhysics.RigidBodyAPI.Apply(prim.GetPrim())
    UsdPhysics.CollisionAPI.Apply(prim.GetPrim())
    return prim.GetPrim()


def stage_for(case):
    stage = Usd.Stage.CreateInMemory()
    UsdGeom.SetStageUpAxis(stage, UsdGeom.Tokens.z)
    stage.SetDefaultPrim(UsdGeom.Xform.Define(stage, "/World").GetPrim())
    UsdPhysics.Scene.Define(stage, "/World/scene")
    floor = UsdGeom.Cube.Define(stage, "/World/floor")
    floor.AddTranslateOp().Set(Gf.Vec3d(0, 0, -1))
    UsdPhysics.CollisionAPI.Apply(floor.GetPrim())  # static collider
    if case == "selfCollisionEnabled":
        links = [collider(stage, f"/World/L{i}", (x, 0, 1)) for i, x in enumerate((0.0, 0.15, 0.05))]
        UsdPhysics.ArticulationRootAPI.Apply(links[0])
        links[0].ApplyAPI("NewtonArticulationRootAPI")
        links[0].CreateAttribute("newton:selfCollisionEnabled", Sdf.ValueTypeNames.Bool).Set(False)
        for name, b0, b1, p0, p1 in (("j01", 0, 1, 0.075, -0.075), ("j12", 1, 2, -0.05, 0.05)):
            joint = UsdPhysics.RevoluteJoint.Define(stage, f"/World/{name}")
            joint.CreateBody0Rel().AddTarget(links[b0].GetPath())
            joint.CreateBody1Rel().AddTarget(links[b1].GetPath())
            joint.CreateLocalPos0Attr(Gf.Vec3f(p0, 0, 0))
            joint.CreateLocalPos1Attr(Gf.Vec3f(p1, 0, 0))
            joint.CreateAxisAttr("Z")
        return stage
    a = UsdGeom.Xform.Define(stage, "/World/A")
    a.AddTranslateOp().Set(Gf.Vec3d(0, 0, 0.05))
    UsdPhysics.RigidBodyAPI.Apply(a.GetPrim())
    geom_a = collider(stage, "/World/A/geom", (0, 0, 0), body=False)
    b = collider(stage, "/World/B", (0.1, 0, 0.05))
    source, target = {
        "body -> body": (a.GetPrim(), "/World/B"),
        "body -> static collider": (a.GetPrim(), "/World/floor"),
        "body -> collider of a body": (b, "/World/A/geom"),
        "collider -> body": (geom_a, "/World/B"),
    }[case]
    UsdPhysics.FilteredPairsAPI.Apply(source).CreateFilteredPairsRel().AddTarget(target)
    return stage


for case in ("body -> body", "body -> static collider", "body -> collider of a body", "collider -> body", "selfCollisionEnabled"):
    path = tempfile.mkdtemp() + "/scene.usda"
    stage = stage_for(case)
    stage.GetRootLayer().Export(path)
    try:
        model = mujoco.MjSpec.from_file(path).compile()
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"{case:28} compile error: {str(e).splitlines()[0]}")
        continue
    data = mujoco.MjData(model)
    mujoco.mj_forward(model, data)
    name = lambda g: mujoco.mj_id2name(model, mujoco.mjtObj.mjOBJ_BODY, int(model.geom_bodyid[g])) or "world"
    pairs = sorted({tuple(sorted((name(c.geom1), name(c.geom2)))) for c in data.contact[: data.ncon]})
    print(f"{case:28} nexclude={model.nexclude} contacts={pairs}")
```

</details>

```
body -> body                 nexclude=1 contacts=[('/World/A', 'world'), ('/World/B', 'world')]
body -> static collider      compile error: Error: body '/World/floor' not found in bodypair 0
body -> collider of a body   compile error: Error: body '/World/A/geom' not found in bodypair 0
collider -> body             nexclude=0 contacts=[('/World/A', '/World/B'), ('/World/A', 'world'), ('/World/B', 'world')]
selfCollisionEnabled         nexclude=0 contacts=[('/World/L0', '/World/L2')]
```

The last two rows should have no contact between `/World/A` and `/World/B`, and none between `/World/L0` and `/World/L2`.

### Environment

`mujoco` 4.0.1, `mujoco-usd` 4.0.1, `usd-core` 25.11, `newton-usd-schemas` 0.7.0, Python 3.12, Linux x86_64 (Ubuntu, kernel 6.8).
new_candidates.title: USD decoder: PhysicsFilteredPairsAPI fails or is ignored for collider endpoints, and newton:selfCollisionEnabled is not read
